title: Jonah and the Whale
subtitle: A story of listening, mercy and a great deep breath
retellingNote: A gentle retelling of Jonah fleeing, being rescued by a great fish, and choosing mercy for Nineveh.

spreads.title: Jonah hears a call
spreads.stagingNote: Show Jonah at the shore with his boat behind him. The far whale hints at the rescue to come; all image choices and placement are invented stage directions.

segments.text: God called Jonah to go to Nineveh, but Jonah turned toward the sea.

interaction.label: Listen to Jonah
interaction.response: Jonah pauses and listens for the quiet call.

interaction.label: Meet the great fish
interaction.response: A gentle whale waits beyond the waves.

spreads.title: A great fish rescues Jonah
spreads.stagingNote: Let the whale rise as the story turns from fear to rescue. Jonah is a small figure against the deep blue, with the sandy print anchoring the paper theatre.

segments.text: A great fish carried Jonah through the deep, and Jonah prayed from its quiet shelter.

interaction.label: Pray with Jonah
interaction.response: Jonah remembers that mercy reaches farther than the sea.

spreads.title: Mercy reaches Nineveh
spreads.stagingNote: End with Jonah facing a small city horizon. The whale returns as a quiet visual echo while the message turns toward compassion.

segments.text: Jonah went to Nineveh, and God showed mercy when the people turned toward what was good.

interaction.label: Choose mercy
interaction.response: God's compassion is wider than Jonah expected.
